title: Lighthouse Christian Products Co. Coffee Mug Isaiah 43:4 Floral Red & White
descriptionText:
Enjoy your hot or cold beverage in this beautiful Lighthouse Christian Products Co. coffee mug. The round, small-sized ceramic mug features a lovely floral pattern in multicolor, with a diameter of 3 1/8". The mug is designed with a handle and is perfect for all occasions. 

This modern style, dishwasher and microwave safe mug is an original piece and is ideal for unisex adults. The mug is decorated with the religious theme of Isaiah 43:4 and is perfect for use at home or in the office. Get your hands on this lovely piece of collectible today!
